tools.name: search_data
tools.description: Search current metadata from e-Gov Data Portal and Statistics Dashboard, then return a short ranked list with publisher, formats, coverage, usage terms, and official links.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run one allowlisted, bounded HTTPS GET contract and return extracted values, provenance, and an integrity receipt.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Check receipt and result hashes plus the execution envelope against the reviewed catalog. This detects later modification; it does not prove publisher authenticity or current freshness.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "execute" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
